hardware_note: This exact build (quiet log, 623,680 bytes) booted on the owner board on 26 Nov 2026 in a short practice run: REPLAY PASS, codec OK, 16 kHz capture, 0 overflow, 0 skipped. The previous build (double-precision FFT, 623,984 bytes) ran on the owner board on 26 Nov 2026: it passed REPLAY and SELFTEST and captured audio, but its feature step took about 957 ms per one-second window, the I2S queue overflowed and every window was reset. This build moves features and inference to a second task (core 1), uses a single-precision FFT with a precomputed twiddle table, normalises features once and enlarges the DMA queue to 32 descriptors. Agreement with the earlier double-precision build: 1377 of 1377 labels, max log-mel difference 0.00347, max logit difference 0.000135 (tests/float_parity.py). The first run of the fixed build on the board (26 Nov 2026) showed 0 overflow, 0 skipped windows, front_us about 51 ms, infer_us about 21 ms; stop and yes fired, go and no stayed below the 0.90 gate. This build adds a quiet log mode (default) and a verbose option (CONFIG_KORVO_KWS_VERBOSE_LOG); decisions and numerics are unchanged.
hardware_scope: short practice runs only on one board; no formal trial recorded
